<thought>We need a retrosynthetic template that disconnects the target by breaking a C–C bond formed in a cycloaddition and, in the forward direction, eliminates a ketone functional group. The catalog uses the term “ketones” for that functional group, so we search for templates that break “ketones” and form a C–C single bond (6‑6).</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "COC(C1(C=C1[Si](C)(C)C)/C=C/C2=CC=CC=C2)=O",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones"],
  "bonds_formed": ["6-6"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
